sendScene.warmingCaption: Preparing: locating your coins in the chain{{details}} — done once, never again
sendScene.signingCaption: Signing on your device — your key never leaves it
sendScene.broadcastingCaption: Sealed and shielded — broadcasting to the network
sendScene.slowCaption: Locating your coins in the chain — this can take a minute or two
sendScene.provingCaption: Building your zero-knowledge proof — nobody will see amount or recipient
sendScene.reassure: Nothing has been sent yet and nothing can be lost — keep this open.

txDetail.explorerNote: The explorer shows only that a shielded transaction happened — never its details.

accessTokenSetting.title: Show access-token field
accessTokenSetting.detail: Adds a token box to wallet-server setup. Only needed for a token-protected wallet server.

watchOnAnotherDevice.noKey: This device does not hold the key for this wallet.
watchOnAnotherDevice.intro: Your view key lets another device or tool watch this wallet — balance, history and where you send, read-only. It can never send.
watchOnAnotherDevice.warn: Anyone with this key sees every amount and memo this wallet has ever had, and everything it receives from now on — you can't undo that without moving your coins.
watchOnAnotherDevice.otherDevice: On the other device: open the wallet → Watch a wallet, then paste this key (or scan the QR).

stopWatching.intro: This device holds a view key and no spending key, so it can show the balance and history — including where this wallet sent — and cannot send. Nothing here can move coins.
stopWatching.warn: Removes the view key from this browser. Anyone else holding the link keeps their view — that can only be ended by moving the coins.

appearanceCard.title: Accent color
appearanceCard.intro: Balance, buttons and highlights. Teal is the ZKas signature.

signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.intro: Prove you control your address without spending from it, or check somebody else's proof.

aboutCard.title: About
aboutCard.blurb: ZKas Wallet — every balance and payment shielded by Orchard zero-knowledge proofs. Your spending key is held on this device and never sent anywhere.

contactPicker.title: Choose a contact
contactPicker.empty: No contacts yet. Save one after a payment, or from a received address — on a shielded chain the wallet is the only place an address can have a name.

saveContactDialog.title: Save contact
saveContactDialog.name: Name
saveContactDialog.storedOnDevice: Stored only on this device — a list of who you pay is exactly the metadata ZKas exists to protect.

contactsCard.title: Contacts
contactsCard.empty: Nobody saved yet. Naming an address here is the only way it will ever read as a person — the chain itself knows nothing about who anyone is.

editContact.name: Name
editContact.removeBody: Only the name is forgotten — any payments you made are untouched, and the address itself stays in your history.

rescanButton.rescanning: Rescanning — this tab updates as it catches up.

requestAmount.hint: The payer's wallet fills in the amount and note — they can still change them.

receive.title: Receive
receive.seedMoved: Looking for your recovery seed? It moved to Settings → Recovery seed, behind your app lock.

revealSeedCard.noKey: This device doesn't hold this wallet's key — it is never sent to the server. Restore it with your recovery phrase or backup.
revealSeedCard.introPhrase: These words restore this wallet and every account under it. Reveal only somewhere private.
revealSeedCard.introSeed: This seed is the only way to restore this wallet. Reveal only somewhere private.
revealSeedCard.privateWarn: Make sure nobody can see your screen. The next tap puts your spending key on it.
revealSeedCard.keepPrivate: Keep this private. Anyone with it controls your funds.

qrScanner.denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access, or paste the address instead.
qrScanner.noCamera: No camera found on this device — paste the address instead.
qrScanner.failed: Couldn't start the camera. Paste the address instead.
qrScanner.hint: Point the camera at the recipient's address QR code
